question.text: Which of the following order types is currently NOT available on the Indian Exchange trading system as per SEBI directives?

answer.text: AON (All or None) and MF (Minimum Fill) orders

explanation.text: The Logic: The source explicitly states that AON and MF orders are currently not available on the system as per SEBI directives, which makes option A correct. The Trap: Confusing AON/MF (not available) with IOC, DQ and Stop Loss, which are described elsewhere in the same chapter as available order types. Note: The source also states that GTC and GTD orders are currently not available as per SEBI directives, in addition to AON and MF.
